description: A moody nighttime garden vignette centered on a landscaped planting bed beside a pale stone or travertine paved terrace. The paving is large-format irregular or sawn stone in a warm cream tone. The garden bed behind is densely planted with a mix of ornamental shrubs: on the left, a dark burgundy-leafed shrub with delicate small foliage; in the center-back, a mid-green rounded form; and on the right, a silvery-gray textured lavender cotton or artemisia plant. All the plantings are illuminated in warm amber from a ground-level source, glowing vividly against the very dark near-black night sky background. The overall lighting creates a theatrical, intimate garden atmosphere with strong foreground illumination fading to deep darkness above. The palette is warm amber light, burgundy-red foliage, deep green, silvery sage, and pale cream stone. Camera at a low angle, approximately 2 to 3 feet off the ground, centered on the garden composition in a vignette frame at normal to slightly telephoto focal length, with the stone paving in the immediate foreground. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
